company.name: Beeper
company.shortDescription: Beeper allows users to chat across multiple platforms, simplifying the messaging experience.
company.description: ​Beeper is a messaging app designed to consolidate multiple chat platforms into a single, streamlined interface. Beeper was acquired by Automattic in April 2024. The company aims to simplify communication by allowing users to manage conversations across various networks from one application. ​

productsAndServices.description: A single application that consolidates messaging from over 10 different chat networks into one interface, syncing messages across devices.
productsAndServices.name: Beeper Universal Chat App

productsAndServices.description: A privacy-focused chat client that connects directly to third-party chat services without relying on Beeper’s cloud infrastructure, storing data locally with end-to-end encryption.
productsAndServices.name: Beeper Mini

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based service that stores encrypted message contents and attachments with end-to-end encryption, enabling message synchronization across devices.
productsAndServices.name: Beeper Cloud

productsAndServices.description: A unified messaging app update adding Line integration, Raycast support, stickers, UI tweaks, and improved iMessage features.
productsAndServices.name: Beeper unified messaging app

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 74 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 41 (+1).
